name: @plusguard/anchor
description: In-page scrolling from HTML attributes: to a section, the top or the bottom, with a set duration — with or without Lenis. A back-to-top button that shows after a set scroll and steps out of the way of marked elements. Zero dependencies, framework-agnostic. CSS included.

scripts.build: npx -p typescript tsc index.ts --outDir dist --declaration --target es2020 --module es2020 --lib dom,es2020 --strict

author: PlusGuard
